name: Ginmetsu no Solfina
source:
The year is 2037. An alien invasion known as the "Silver Ruin" has devastated the world, and the only ones who can fight the invading "Seraxites" are girl warriors called Solfina, clad in special combat suits called "Solace Veils". As the war drags on, the megacorporation NS (Net Stella) has taken control of everything from Solfina training and Veil development to video streaming and entertainment, ruling society as a corporate dictatorship.

K, once a Veil designer at NS, was fired for his self-righteous personality and his obsessive refusal to design anything but lewd Veils. He now scrapes by running a shabby lab in the slums. One day, he is visited by Hizaki Suina, who became the youngest-ever top-ranked "Prime Star" Solfina and a national hero before being driven out of NS by a conspiracy. She asks him to make her a new Veil, and the two outcasts team up. With NS obstructing her every attempt to regain her fame, they turn to the one loophole NS will not ban: lewd streaming.

[From DLsite, translated]
